extracted.name: Creamy Keto Cauliflower Risotto
extracted.description: Cauliflower risotto is a delicious low-carb side dish. With meaty mushrooms, cream, and Parmesan cheese, you won't even realize it's made with no rice!
instruction_lines: Melt ghee in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion and garlic; cook and stir until tender, about 3 minutes. Stir in grated cauliflower and cook for 3 minutes. Add mushrooms and cook until tender, about 3 minutes.
Stir Parmesan, cream, salt, pepper, and nutmeg into the skillet; cook over medium heat until creamy, 5 to 7 minutes.
